server.name: zero-to-hundred-marketplace
server.title: Zero to Hundred marketplace
server.description: Find live software licenses, compare software, and prepare Builder-owned draft listings and source uploads.

live.instructions: Marketplace search is public. Builder listing tools require an OAuth grant for this MCP resource or a scoped Personal Access Token. They create and edit drafts and attach verified source archives. Final review and publishing remain in the web wizard.

tools.name: z2h_search_marketplace
tools.title: Search marketplace software
tools.description: Find live software by keyword before building from scratch. Public, no sign-in needed. Returns descriptions, USD license prices, tech stacks and listing links. Example: {"search": "invoice", "limit": 5}. Empty search browses recent software. When hasMore is true without nextCursor, narrow the search. Matching is lexical. Errors set isError; retry a rate limit later. Use z2h_compare_marketplace_listings for a shortlist or z2h_show_marketplace for cards. A result does not guarantee suitability or purchase availability.

search.description: Keywords describing the software the Buyer needs.

type.description: Categories matching the kind of software the Buyer wants. Omission searches across categories.

mode.description: Filter by the listing's sale model. Omission leaves the sale model unfiltered.

operatingStatus.description: Filter by software readiness or existing commercial operation, rather than listing publication state.

domains.description: Industry tags for the software. Choose keys from the Zero to Hundred taxonomy: ai, analytics, art-design, auth-identity, cms, conference, developer-tools, devops, e-commerce-marketplace, education, entertainment, environmental, fashion, finance, food, gaming, graphic-design, health, interior-design, marketing, membership, messaging, non-profit, political, productivity, real-estate, religious, services, social, technology, travel, ux-ui, wedding, other. Omission searches across industries.

sort.description: Result order. Defaults to relevance for a search, otherwise newest.

limit.description: Number of listings to return in this page. Omission uses 20.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Keep the same filters and sort.

slug.description: Public identifier for comparison, display, and listing links.

licensePrice.description: Current USD license price, or null when unset.

listingUrl.description: Public listing page. Open it to review or purchase.

results.description: Live public software matching the filters.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null if cursor paging is unavailable or finished.

hasMore.description: More matches exist. If nextCursor is null, narrow the search instead of paging.

searchMode.description: Text uses keyword matching, not semantic similarity.

tools.name: z2h_create_draft_listing
tools.title: Create a Zero to Hundred draft listing
tools.description: Create an invisible draft and return editUrl and publishUrl. Price and source inclusion are Builder decisions. Set sourceCodeIncluded only after confirmation; omitted values default to false. Requires listings:write. Returns the draft identity and web edit/review links. Check z2h_list_my_listings before retrying, because creation is not idempotent. Source delivery, review and publishing continue in the web wizard.

title.description: Name Buyers will see on the software listing.

shortDescription.description: Buyer-facing summary shown on marketplace cards.

longDescription.description: What the software does, who it helps, and what the Buyer receives.

type.description: Software category that best matches its main use.

operatingStatus.description: State of the software itself, independent of the listing publication status.

domains.description: Industry tags for the software. Choose keys from the Zero to Hundred taxonomy: ai, analytics, art-design, auth-identity, cms, conference, developer-tools, devops, e-commerce-marketplace, education, entertainment, environmental, fashion, finance, food, gaming, graphic-design, health, interior-design, marketing, membership, messaging, non-profit, political, productivity, real-estate, religious, services, social, technology, travel, ux-ui, wedding, other. Omission creates a draft without industry tags.

askingPrice.description: USD license price confirmed by the Builder. Omit if undecided.

demoUrl.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS demo URL. Omit when no demo is available.

sourceRepoUrl.description: GitHub repository URL. Connecting and verifying source continues in the web wizard.

techStack.description: Frameworks and languages used by the software.

name.description: Name of a service the Buyer needs to operate the software, such as Stripe.

note.description: What the software needs this service for.

cost.description: Expected service cost, such as USD 20/month.

externalDependencies.description: Third-party services a Buyer must provision. Common values: Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Upstash, Firebase, PlanetScale, Neon, Clerk, Auth0, Stripe, PayPal, Plaid, Resend, SendGrid, Postmark, Twilio, OpenAI, Anthropic.

sourceCodeIncluded.description: Whether the sale includes source code. Omission records false. Set true only after the Builder confirms that source code is included.

question.description: Buyer question addressed by the paired answer.

faqs.description: Supplying FAQs disables the automatic FAQ draft.

thumbnailUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS image URL for the marketplace thumbnail.

imageUrls.description: HTTP or HTTPS screenshot URLs. The first image becomes the thumbnail.

videoUploadUrl.description: A YouTube or Loom demo URL.

associatedListingIds.description: IDs of related listings owned by this Builder, obtained from z2h_list_my_listings.

tools.name: z2h_list_my_listings
tools.title: List my Zero to Hundred listings
tools.description: Find the authenticated Builder's drafts and live listings before creating another draft. Requires listings:read. Returns items with slugs, publication state, USD prices, edit links, and nextCursor. Pass nextCursor to continue paging; null ends the list. An invalid or expired token requires sign-in again.

limit.description: Number of owned listings to return per page. Omission uses 25, with newest listings first.

cursor.description: Continue after the last listing in the preceding result. Use that response's nextCursor; omission starts at the newest listing.

tools.name: z2h_get_listing
tools.title: Get my Zero to Hundred listing
tools.description: Read one owned listing before editing it. Requires listings:read. Use a slug from z2h_list_my_listings. This does not download source code.

tools.name: z2h_request_source_upload
tools.title: Request a draft source archive upload
tools.description: For an owned draft, get a short-lived signed archive URL. Ask the Builder to explicitly accept this exact statement: "I own or have the rights to sell the codebase I am about to upload." Pass ownershipAccepted=true and ownershipVersion=2026-09-27 only after they accept. Returns signedUrl for the archive PUT, objectKey for confirmation, and contentType for the upload header. Keep signedUrl private. PUT up to 100 MB to signedUrl, then call z2h_confirm_source_upload. This does not publish.

slug.description: Owned listing slug from z2h_list_my_listings or z2h_create_draft_listing.

contentType.description: Archive MIME type, used unchanged for PUT and confirmation.

sizeBytes.description: Exact archive size in bytes. Must match the uploaded file.

ownershipAccepted.description: True only after the Builder explicitly accepts the statement in this tool description.

ownershipVersion.description: Version of the ownership statement explicitly accepted by the Builder.

annotations.title: Request a draft source archive upload

signedUrl.description: Short-lived signed PUT URL. Keep it private and upload the archive before confirmation.

objectKey.description: Storage key to pass unchanged to z2h_confirm_source_upload.

contentType.description: Content-Type to use for the archive PUT and confirmation.

tools.name: z2h_confirm_source_upload
tools.title: Confirm a draft source archive upload
tools.description: After the signed PUT succeeds, verify and attach the archive to the owned draft. Confirm that the Builder accepted "I own or have the rights to sell the codebase I am about to upload."; pass ownershipAccepted=true and ownershipVersion=2026-09-27. The server records the accepted wording with the source change. Final review and publishing stay in the web wizard.

slug.description: Owned listing slug from z2h_list_my_listings or z2h_create_draft_listing.

objectKey.description: Storage key returned by z2h_request_source_upload. Pass it unchanged.

contentType.description: Archive MIME type, used unchanged for PUT and confirmation.

sizeBytes.description: Exact archive size in bytes. Must match the uploaded file.

ownershipAccepted.description: True only after the Builder explicitly accepts the statement in this tool description.

ownershipVersion.description: Version of the ownership statement explicitly accepted by the Builder.

annotations.title: Confirm a draft source archive upload

ok.description: The archive was verified and attached, or this same archive was already attached. Publishing remains in the web wizard.

tools.name: z2h_compare_marketplace_listings
tools.title: Compare marketplace software
tools.description: Compare a shortlist of public software from marketplace search. Returns current public descriptions, USD license prices, types and tech stacks. Unavailable software is omitted without disclosing its status. This tool cannot purchase software or access private source.

items.description: Public listing slug returned by z2h_search_marketplace.

slugs.description: Listing identifiers to compare, in the order the Buyer wants them presented. Copy each slug from z2h_search_marketplace.

slug.description: Public identifier for comparison, display, and listing links.

licensePrice.description: Current USD license price, or null when unset.

listingUrl.description: Public listing page. Open it to review or purchase.

results.description: Current live software, in selection order when slugs were supplied.

nextCursor.description: Selection refreshes do not paginate. Use marketplace search for paging.

hasMore.description: This response contains the complete refreshed selection.

unavailableSlugs.description: Requested slugs unavailable publicly. Their private status is never disclosed.

tools.name: z2h_show_marketplace
tools.title: Show marketplace software
tools.description: Show public software cards and an interactive comparison panel. First search with z2h_search_marketplace, then pass the public slugs to display, and the search text you used as `search` so the panel shows what the cards are for. Without slugs, shows the newest live software. Prices and availability are refreshed on the server. Listing links open the Zero to Hundred website.

slugs.description: Search-result slugs to show. Omit to display the newest live software.

items.description: Public listing slug returned by z2h_search_marketplace.

search.description: Text to prefill the panel's search box. Use the query that produced the supplied slugs. Cards are selected by slugs; this text does not filter them.

tools.name: z2h_show_marketplace
tools.title: Show marketplace software
tools.description: Show public software cards and an interactive comparison panel. First search with z2h_search_marketplace, then pass the public slugs to display, and the search text you used as `search` so the panel shows what the cards are for. Without slugs, shows the newest live software. Prices and availability are refreshed on the server. Listing links open the Zero to Hundred website.

slugs.description: Search-result slugs to show. Omit to display the newest live software.
